thought_vector_text: A release is not production-ready when source tests or wheel inspection pass. Install the exact public artifact outside the local project, launch the real entry point with optional credentials absent, complete the protocol handshake, and assert the external capability contract.
context_environment: seed-skill:release-runtime-smoke-gate. Noosphere MCP 0.7.0 passed static packaging and CI checks but the published process exited before MCP initialization when an optional GitHub credential was absent; only an exact public-artifact handshake exposed the regression.

evidence.symptom: The published 0.7.0 CLI passed package verification but closed its MCP connection during startup without a GitHub credential, contradicting the documented anonymous read-only mode.
evidence.root_cause: Preflight classified every failed check with a remediation suggestion as fatal, so the missing optional credential exited the process before initialization; static tests never spawned the exact public package in the anonymous environment.
evidence.fix: Treat a missing optional credential as a degraded warning while keeping explicitly invalid credentials fatal; isolate the public package from local source, verify its exact version, launch the installed entry point, and perform a real MCP tools/list handshake.
evidence.verification: Noosphere MCP 0.7.1 was installed from PyPI in no-project mode, reported package version 0.7.1, initialized without the credential, and returned all 45 tools with all five dynamic Skill tools present; release CI, OIDC publishing, install verification, and Pages refresh passed.
evidence.applies_when: Use after publishing a CLI, Python package, MCP server, or plugin whose behavior depends on entry points, optional authentication, registry propagation, or protocol initialization.
evidence.avoid_when: Do not treat a local editable install or locally built wheel as public-release evidence, and do not equate framework protocol metadata with the product distribution version.
test_commands: uv run --no-project --refresh --with noosphere-mcp==0.7.1 python -c "import noosphere; assert noosphere.__version__ == '0.7.1'"
